events.source_name: US National Weather Service Active Alerts
events.summary:
* WHAT...For the Small Craft Advisory, northeast winds 15 to 25
kt with gusts up to 30 kt and seas 5 to 8 ft. For the Gale
Watch, north winds 20 to 30 kt with gusts up to 40 kt and seas
8 to 13 ft possible.

* WHERE...Coastal waters from Cape May NJ to Cape Henlopen DE
out 20 NM and Coastal waters from Cape Henlopen to Fenwick
Island DE out 20 NM.

* WHEN...For the Small Craft Advisory, until 6 AM EDT Monday.
For the Gale Watch, from Monday morning through Tuesday
afternoon.

* IMPACTS...Strong winds can cause hazardous seas which could
capsize or damage vessels and reduce visibility.

events.title: US National Weather Service Active Alerts
events.region: San Diego County Coastal Areas; Orange County Coastal
events.source_name: US National Weather Service Active Alerts
events.summary:
* WHAT...Dangerous rip currents and breaking waves due to elevated
surf expected. Surf will build to 3 to 6 feet with sets to 7
feet on Sunday and persist through Tuesday morning.

* WHERE...San Diego County Coastal Areas and Orange County Coastal
Areas. Highest waves on south and southwest facing beaches.

* WHEN...From 9 AM PDT this morning through Tuesday morning.

* IMPACTS...There is an increased risk of ocean drowning. Rip
currents can pull swimmers and surfers out to sea. Waves can
wash people off beaches and rocks, and capsize small boats
nearshore.

* ADDITIONAL DETAILS...Minor beach erosion may occur across south-
facing beaches.
